claim: TIL Bill Gates Sr. is 2 meters tall : r/tall - Reddit
summary: The Bill Gates of Microsoft is William H. Gates III, and he is the fourth generation with that name. His father, the tall one, is William H. Gates Sr. He was born as William H. Gates II, changed it to William Gates Jr. while in the army during WWII, then changed it to Sr. to distinguish himself from his son.
